what_differs: WAGR-109 (Open, Phase 1, Should Have) plans a Payouts related list on the Player with Payout ID, Period and Batch columns. That design came from the prototype. On 09-25 the team decided that player payouts need no separate workflow or batching: the signup and redeposit records track them. The payout build covers referrer payments only.
suggested_action: Re-scope or cancel WAGR-109. If the client still wants to see player payout data on the Player, define it from signup and redeposit fields (for example in a report or the existing Sign-Ups related list), not from a Payout object.
